capabilities.description: Inspect genuine engine imports or prepare a private pinned environment.

usage.purpose: Inspect genuine engine imports or prepare a private pinned environment.
usage.inputs: {action:"inspect"|"prepare",pythonPath?}; prepare uses existing CPython 3.12 and installs only into a private venv.
usage.outputs: {ready,pythonPath,versions,environmentDigest,reason?}; ready reflects actual imports and the validated dependency lock.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Resolve a strategy factor need through exact evidence reuse, reevaluation or bounded search.

usage.purpose: Resolve a strategy factor need through exact evidence reuse, reevaluation or bounded search.
usage.inputs: {draft:{requestId,need,source,layout,space,profile,references,budget,strategyId?,poolId?}}. References are library factor IDs. Freeze fields, UTC splits, target, diagnostics and budgets.
usage.outputs: {resolution:"reuse",factors} or {resolution:"research",job}; the native workflow continues after the prompt receipt.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

configurationRequirements.reason: Prepare or select the verified Qlib/DEAP/Optuna environment before numerical work.

capabilities.description: Compute existing formulas, evaluate immutable values, or perform both independently of search.

usage.purpose: Compute existing formulas, evaluate immutable values, or perform both independently of search.
usage.inputs: Compute: {mode,requestId,budget,source,layout,formulas}. Evaluate: {mode,requestId,budget,valuesRef,profile,references}. Both combines those computation and evaluation fields.
usage.outputs: Job; compute evidence includes a Values reference reusable by evaluate-only. Full arrays stay in immutable matrix shards.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

configurationRequirements.reason: Prepare or select the verified Qlib/DEAP/Optuna environment before numerical work.

capabilities.description: Read or control the native factor job and page retained evidence.

usage.purpose: Read or control the native factor job and page retained evidence.
usage.inputs: {action,jobId,interruptIds?,cursor?,limit?}; resume names observed interrupt IDs. Pause reaches a safe checkpoint; cancel fences later writes.
usage.outputs: Job with optional evidence/trials pages, interruptIds, reportStatus/reportError and valuesRef. Status reports actual execution state.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Query immutable factor definitions and separately versioned evidence, or add an annotation.

usage.purpose: Query immutable factor definitions and separately versioned evidence, or add an annotation.
usage.inputs: Query: {action:"query",query}. Read: {action:"read",factorId,cursor?,limit?}. Annotate: {action:"annotate",factorId,note,operationId}. Numerical metrics cannot be submitted.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Apply an explicit external strategy decision to its factor pool or attach application evidence.

usage.purpose: Apply an explicit external strategy decision to its factor pool or attach application evidence.
usage.inputs: Read: {action:"read",poolId}. Decide: {action:"decide",change:{operationId,poolId,strategyId,expectedVersion,decision,factorIds,replaces,purpose,reason,strategyVersion,applicationEvidence}}. Feedback supplies observed strategy/pool versions and refs.
usage.outputs: Pool or a fixed feedback reference. Mining never changes pool membership; the caller owns the strategy decision.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Execute one resumable host-owned factor job.

usage.purpose: Execute one resumable host-owned factor job.
usage.inputs: {jobId}; host-only native execution receives its actual Run context.
usage.outputs: Job after checkpoint, interruption or completion.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Read the saved environment selection for unified configuration.

usage.purpose: Read the saved environment selection for unified configuration.
usage.inputs: {}; reads selected configuration without installation or numerical work.
usage.outputs: {pythonPath,ready}; execution rechecks the actual environment before computing.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.

capabilities.description: Verify and select an existing compatible Python environment.

usage.purpose: Verify and select an existing compatible Python environment.
usage.inputs: {pythonPath,command_id,expected_version?}; only existing dependencies are probed; use factor_environment prepare for installation.
limitations: All data and formulas must satisfy the frozen qlib-expr/1 contract; results retain missing evidence and exclusions.
